title: Prevalent Display sues Samsung over four former Innolux AMOLED patents
content: US-based Prevalent Display LLC, an IP company (a non-practicing entity,. or NPE), has filed a lawsuit against Samsung Display, Samsung Electronics and Samsung Electronics America in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Texas. title: TCL CSOT shows world's first OLED smartphone displays with blue PSF emitters
content: TCL CSOT showed its first PSF emitter powered OLED displays at its DTC 2026 event. The company says that these are the world's first blue phosphorescent OLEDs for smartphone or camera applications. The displays are a 6.36-inch smartphone display and a 2.86-inch display for compact cameras. title: The OLED Marketplace reaches 200 displays with BOE's 48" ultra-wide transparent OLED as our 200th listing
content: We are happy to announce a milestone: the OLED Marketplace, OLED-Info's free catalog of commercial OLED displays, now lists 200 displays! Fittingly, the 200th panel is a large and unique one - BOE's 48" ultra-wide transparent OLED display (BOE-TR-48).
